notes: Network opened about 14:07 UTC; county pages and PDFs below were fetched directly through the fetch module (the first Elections.2026 fetch succeeded at about 14:05 UTC). Elections are run by the County Clerk/Elections Administrator Jana Kennon. Contact: county Elections home page (fetch_module, hash ad3e8af5...) reads 'Jana Kennon County Clerk/Elections Administrator 1700 Wilbarger Street, Room 15 Vernon, TX 76384 Phone: 940-552-5486' with an Email link mailto:jkennon@co.wilbarger.tx.us; the SOS Election Duties page (fetch_module, hash 065e1ebd...) lists WILBARGER COUNTY, County Clerk Jana Kennon, (940) 552-5486, County Email Address mailto:jkennon@co.wilbarger.tx.us. Results are scanned PDFs (Creator: Xerox AltaLink C8155) posted on the county Elections 2026 and Past Elections pages. What the PDFs show (read from the page images): every posted unofficial (election-night) report for the three target elections is a county-level 'Cumulative Results Report' with only Absentee / Early Voting / Election Day / Total columns, no precinct breakdown. Nov 5 2024 'Unofficial Results' (unofficial_results_1152024.pdf): Run Time 8:39 PM, Run Date 11/05/2024, Precincts Reporting 10 of 10; PDF scan CreationDate 2024-11-07, so it was posted no earlier than Nov 7. Mar 3 2026 'Primary Party Election - Unofficial Results': Run Time 8:56 PM, Run Date 03/03/2026, Precincts Reporting 0 of 4; PDF CreateDate 2026-03-03T21:09:21-06:00, ModDate 2026-03-04T07:40:20-06:00. May 26 2026 'Unofficial Results for Primary Party Runoff Election': Run Time 7:29 PM, Run Date 05/26/2026, Precincts Reporting 0 of 4; PDF CreateDate 2026-05-27T08:42:18-06:00. The official (post-canvass) reports for Nov 2024 (doc019_11.19.pdf, Run Date 11/13/2024) and Mar 2026 (Run Date 03/04/2026 per header, PDF created 2026-03-13) are also county-level Cumulative Results Reports with no precinct breakdown. No precinct-by-precinct results report was found on either page. Why UNKNOWN: precinct-level results never appear in anything posted, so LIVE_PRECINCT and PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT are contradicted, but COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS also needs precinct detail later and none was found; NO_SITE_OR_SOS_ONLY does not fit because the county posts results itself. Reviewer flag: observed pattern is county totals only, no precinct detail published at any point found. The Elections home page also links to the SOS results site results.texas-election.com under 'Election Results & Turnout Data'. Usage notice: the fetched Elections.2026 and Elections home pages contain no distribution or usage notice text, so usage_notice_text is empty. Stated change: no 2025/2026 statement about precinct-level reporting found; 2026 runoff notices of consolidated precincts (19-1, 21-20) concern polling, not results reporting. Wayback: wayback_probe (3 CDX windows) failed robots_disallowed_or_unreachable before the network change; after it, archive.org/wayback/available was queried at 12 points (4 per window) for co.wilbarger.tx.us/page/Elections.2026 and every closest snapshot was 20260618012301, outside all windows. Counts: fetch_module_attempts includes the SOS list fetch (shared with other counties, counted here once), 9 county page/PDF fetches, 3 CDX probe attempts and 12 availability queries.
tag_rationale: Primary-source PDFs show only county-level cumulative reports on election night and also at canvass, with no precinct-level report found at any stage, so no timing tag is supported and none of the tag definitions fits. Tag UNKNOWN.
